caseno: Appeal From Original Order No.199 of 1996
lawyer:
Khandker Mahbubuddin Ahmed, with Abdus Salam Khan, Advocates—For the Appellants

parties:
Dr. Ismat Mirza and others ----- Appellants
Vs.
Md. Mosaddique Hossain  and others ----- Respondent
full_judgment: 4. Mr. Khondokar Mahbubuddin Ahmed, learned Advocate for the appellant, submits that the trial Court misunderstood section 85(2) of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act and failed to notice that the right of preemption provided under section 24 of the Act has not been taken away by section 85(2) as held by a Full Bench decision reported in 17 DLR 384. Learned Advocate further submits that the decision in 33 DLR 10 is not applicable in this case wherein the land sought to be preempted was the government Khas land meant for settlement on temporary basis.
